items.title: Marvell Just Dropped 22% in a Week as Nvidia’s Turmoil Hit AI Chips. Sell, or Load Up Before Dec. 1?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell stock fell 22% in a week as Nvidia’s leadership crisis and a California subpoena dragged down AI chip stocks. Marvell put out no bad news of its own, but its all-stock deal for Lumentum ties the two stocks together, so each drop in Marvell also cuts what Lumentum holders get.
